versions.changelog:
-NEW VERSION-  [1.0.2--1.0.3]

CHANGES:
- Improved SKILL.md with better instructions.

NO TECHNICAL CHANGES

-NEW VERSION-  [1.0.1--1.0.2]

FIXES
-----
- place-orders.md: automated mode now explicitly requires five guardrails to be
  in place before enabling (symbol allowlist, notional cap, position limit,
  daily loss limit, paper trading validation first). Automated mode itself is
  still fully supported and unchanged.

- scripts/setup.sh: added post-install version verification — exits with error
  if installed versions do not match pinned versions, with links to PyPI for
  manual hash verification in high-security environments.

- SKILL.md: strengthened credential storage guidance in warnings frontmatter —
  explicitly requires .env file or secret manager, never log credentials, rotate
  USER_SECRET immediately if exposed, recommends dedicated limited-permission
  SnapTrade user for automated trading.

-NEW VERSION-  [1.0.0--1.0.1]

FIXES
-----
- setup.sh: replaced --break-system-packages with a proper virtual environment
- setup.sh: pinned dependency versions (snaptrade-python-sdk==11.0.187, python-dotenv==1.2.2)
- place-orders.md: removed "autonomous/automated execution" framing on force order flow
- place-orders.md: added dual-mode confirmation system (manual mode default, automated mode opt-in)
- SKILL.md: declared all 4 credentials in frontmatter with sensitivity descriptions and privilege notes

ADDITIONS
---------
- README.md: full onboarding guide covering how to get credentials from the SnapTrade dashboard,
  register a user, connect a brokerage, set env vars, and run setup
- references/options-trading.md: option positions, option quotes (BETA), option order impact (BETA),
  single and multi-leg option orders via OCC symbol format
- references/crypto-trading.md: crypto pairs search, crypto quotes, preview crypto order,
  place crypto order with full order type support
- account-data.md: added recent orders (last 24h), single order detail, historical account
  total value (BETA)
- SKILL.md routing table: updated to include options and crypto reference files

Initial release of the SnapTrade Trading Skill.

- Enables executing trades and retrieving account data via the SnapTrade API.
- Supports actions like placing buy/sell orders, checking balances, viewing positions, accessing order history, fetching quotes, cancelling open orders, and refreshing account holdings.
- Provides clear setup instructions and details required environment variables.
- Includes references for common trading and data tasks.
- Lists important operational constraints and best practices.
